features.quote: Max **40 turns** (one turn = one model response + tool execution). 40 is enough to see degradation curves without runaway cost; pilot at 20 first
features.justification_quote: 40 is enough to see degradation curves without runaway cost

features.quote: Terminate early if: tests pass (solvable cells), model calls `submit`, or 3 consecutive turns with no tool call (degenerate stall).
